scope: Small canonical investment-topic vocabulary; multiple tags may apply

topics.business.model: How the company creates and captures value, packaging and monetization mechanisms
topics.product.capability: What a product/service can do and its availability state
topics.financial.performance: Income, revenue, expenses, cash generation and their definitions
topics.financial.position: Balance sheet, liquidity, leverage, funding and solvency conditions
topics.technical.architecture: Implementation, protocols, dependencies and component behavior
topics.technical.limits: Workload scope, constraints, reliability, failure and recovery behavior
topics.unit_economics: Customer or supplier economics per defined unit, including costs and denominators
topics.adoption: Evaluation, pilot, production use, purchase, retention and renewal with stage definitions
topics.competition: Alternatives, substitutes, customer choice and comparative constraints
topics.regulation: Applicable rules, approvals, legal scope and compliance obligations
topics.risk: Specific adverse observations or unresolved dependencies material to a stated question

extension_policy: Preserve proposed unfamiliar tags as provisional. Review semantic overlap before publishing a new stable ID/version; never silently discard the underlying item or remap old labels.
query_policy: Labels support filtering and gap discovery, not automatic exclusion or semantic truth. Unknown/mixed/unclassified items remain discoverable through an exploration route.
